theorems.name: Submission.imc_lintegral_coordNorm_le_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (κ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsMeasureRepresentation Y μ κ → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (κ x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ Y.mass
